newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges up on supplies, strong Asia.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges up on supplies, strong Asia.

text.p: NWE naphtha was a touch firmer on Friday as firmer gasoline, tightish local supplies and support from strong Asian buying impacted.
Dealers said naphtha was around $175 cif NWE, about $1 a tonne higher than Thursday. July swaps were also better bid touching $180.00 on the offer side.
But, activity on both the physical and wet markets was fairly sparse.
"There is not alot of physical around for a start and there is some concern the swaps are being played up," said one trader.
